name: Okendo
tagline: Okendo is a customer marketing platform for Shopify brands that collects and displays product reviews, surveys, and loyalty rewards. Its AI features include review sentiment analysis, AI-generated review response suggestions, and insights on which product attributes drive purchases and returns.
